Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Debashish Mehra. I am a 71-year-old chartered accountant living in Kochi. M/s Coastal Textiles Pvt Ltd gave me a cheque for ₹23,70,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 83945 29272 or email debashish.mehra@example.com.
